testHarnessCorrections: The initial combined run passed all 43 desktop assertions, then its first mobile navigation exceeded the 10-second locator default. Navigation timeout was separated and raised to 45 seconds. The mobile-only retry completed at both widths. Original failed navigation remains recorded in desktopRaw.

A viewport-relative 310 px swipe at 390 px legitimately moved two products while 280 px at 360 px moved one. Diagnostic confirmed poster-012 -> poster-039. The mobile suite now uses the same intentional 240 px swipe at both widths. All 14 mobile/runtime assertions pass; no UI fix was needed.
regressionsRetained: Five rapid keyboard steps in both directions and across both seams retain their committed destinations.
Tap during motion does not strand the stage, drag takeover settles, reduced motion settles to selected poster.
Two-result filters keep two unique DOM identities; hidden side opacity0 aria-hidden and pointerEvents none; center opacity1.
limitations: Visual art-direction review is owned separately by the main agent.
Local preview only; production deployment, real API delivery and physical Safari were not tested.
